description: JSI TRIGA Mark II core geometry from open sources only (no ICSBEP). Values from other GA TRIGA Mark II reactors are marked as such; the JSI-specific ones win where both exist.

sources.svajger2024: I. Švajger et al., Nuclear Engineering and Technology 56 (2024) 1165–1203, doi:10.1016/j.net.2023.11.021
sources.ksu2004: Kansas State University TRIGA Mark II, Safety Analysis Report dated 2004-12-21 (NRC license R-88; public, NRC ADAMS). Standard GA stainless-steel TRIGA element and components; a different reactor, so reactor-specific values (reflector size, rod types) are not used for JSI
sources.trigapulse: JSI TRIGA pulse database, trigapulse.ijs.si: core maps 242.pdf and 246.pdf, rod tables s242.pdf and s246.pdf (downloaded, kept out of git)
sources.castagna2017: C. Castagna et al., A new model with Serpent for the first criticality benchmarks of the TRIGA Mark II reactor, arXiv:1707.05194 (Pavia reactor)

grid.ringRadiiStatus: MISSING: not in svajger2024 or ksu2004. Bound: F ring + element radius (1.877) must stay inside the reflector radius 22.098, so F < 20.22 cm.

ringRadiiCandidateCm.status: UNVERIFIED: quoted by a web-search summary, apparently from JSI's ICTP slides 'Characterisation of the JSI TRIGA reactor' (indico.ictp.it event 7993); the server didn't respond, so not checked against the document. Consistent with the F < 20.22 cm bound.

reflector.source: svajger2024 section 4.2 (radius to the graphite reflector)
reflector.heightSource: ksu2004 (0.559 m; a GA Mark II value, not confirmed for JSI)
reflector.outerStatus: MISSING for JSI (ksu2004's 42 in outer diameter is KSU's)

gridPlates.spacingStatus: castagna2017 gives 64.8 cm for Pavia; not confirmed for JSI

fuelElement.source: ksu2004 (standard 304 SS-clad element: 28.37 in total, 15 in fuel, 3.44 in graphite axial reflectors); fuel length matches svajger2024

controlRods.types: JSI: three B4C rods with fuel followers (safety, shim, regulating) and a transient rod with an air follower (svajger2024)
controlRods.source: ksu2004 (20 in B4C or borated graphite, 30 mil aluminum sheath; 7/8 in and 1.25 in rods). KSU's standard rods may differ from JSI's fuel-followed rods: follower dimensions are MISSING

244.source: trigapulse s246.pdf header (measured 2021-06-08 on core 244; core 246's pulses use this table)

criticalStates.stepsStatus: MISSING: the JSI step size and the rod positions at step 0 are not in the open sources found
